upstream.description: VoiceStudio is the open-source, fully-local ElevenLabs alternative — voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription & audiobook creation in 646 languages.

classification.analysis: VoiceStudio (formerly OmniVoice-Studio) is a local-first, open-source desktop application (Tauri) that bundles 16 TTS engines and 11 ASR engines for voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, and audiobook creation across 646 languages, positioned as a fully offline ElevenLabs alternative. It targets creators and privacy-conscious users who want zero-account, zero-API-key local voice generation with GPU auto-detection (CUDA/MPS/ROCm), and it also exposes a local REST/SSE/WebSocket API, an OpenAI-compatible audio API, and an MCP server for programmatic use. Actively developed in beta with cross-platform installers for macOS, Windows, and Linux plus Docker.

use_cases.title: Clone a voice locally without cloud APIs or subscriptions
Dub a video into another language with speaker preservation
Generate an audiobook from an EPUB/PDF with multiple voices
Run local dictation with system-wide transcription shortcut
